Guidance & outlook: The Bank also continues to hold additional standard asset provision of 12.83 billion Rupees made in Q3 of FY2026 as directed by RBI in respect of the agricultural priority sector portfolio.

Non-interest income, excluding treasury, grew by 16.0% year-on-year to 84.25 billion Rupees in Ql of FY2027. • Fee income increased by 23.5% year-on-year to 72.86 billion Rupees in this quarter off a low base of Ql of last year.
The Bank's operating expenses increased by 10.4% year-on-year in this quarter compared to 11.5% year-on-year in FY2026.
Growth & demand: Net interest income grew by 12.7% year-on-year to ₹24,384 crore in Q1-2027 2.
Fee income grew by 23.5% year-on-year to ₹7,286 crore in Q1-2027 4.
Operating expenses grew by 10.4% year-on-year to ₹12,574 crore in Q1-2027 5.
Margins & costs: Net interest margin was 4.36% in Q1-2027 compared to 4.32% in Q4-2026 3.
Core operating profit grew by 15.6% year-on-year to ₹20,235 crore in Q1-2027 6.
